blind_scope: Only the supplied packet, its three sheets and listed individual images were read. No selection, requests, download manifest, source/category mapping, reviewer A, model scores or inferred source labels were consulted.
notes: Judgments are visual checks under the five supplied criteria. No added freshness or edibility exclusion was imposed; visible decay is recorded explicitly. A criterion marked uncertain is not an affirmative pass.
